mnemonic.meaning: 操 operate + 縦 control: operating the controls.
mnemonic.reading: "SOU, JUU!" (そうじゅう) So, ten (十) levers to pilot.

examples.ja: 父は飛行機を操縦する仕事をしている。
examples.en: My father's job is flying airplanes.

items.note: For planes, ships, machines; also manipulating people. 運転 is for cars.

mnemonic.meaning: 芝 lawn + 生 grow: grass growing.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIBA, FU!" (しばふ) The shiba dog naps on the lawn. Note the special reading ふ.

examples.ja: 芝生に入らないでください。
examples.en: Keep off the grass.

items.note: 芝 alone is turf.

mnemonic.meaning: 容 contain + 器 container: a container.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, KEY!" (ようき) Same sound as 陽気 (cheerful).

examples.ja: 残った料理を容器に入れた。
examples.en: I put the leftovers in a container.

items.note: 入れ物 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 上 up + 達 attain: reaching higher.
mnemonic.reading: "JOU, TATSU!" (じょうたつ) Joe stands tall: he's improved.

examples.ja: 毎日練習して、ピアノが上達した。
examples.en: I practised every day and got better at piano.

items.note: Only for skills. 上手になる is close.

mnemonic.meaning: 煮 has 灬 (fire) at the bottom: cooking over a fire.
mnemonic.reading: "NIRU!" (にる) Same sound as 似る (resemble).

examples.ja: 野菜を弱火で煮た。
examples.en: I simmered the vegetables over low heat.

items.note: Cooking in liquid. 茹でる (Level 24) is boiling in water. 煮える = to be cooked.

mnemonic.meaning: 作 make + 法 method: the method of doing things.
mnemonic.reading: "SA, HOU!" (さほう) Sa, how should I behave?

examples.ja: 茶道の作法を習った。
examples.en: I learned tea ceremony etiquette.

items.note: Formal or traditional manners. 礼儀 (Level 15) is politeness in general.

mnemonic.meaning: 芽 has 艹 (plant) on top: a plant just starting.
mnemonic.reading: "ME!" (め) Same sound as 目 (eye): the plant's first eye.

examples.ja: 春になって木に芽が出た。
examples.en: Spring came and the trees put out buds.

items.note: 芽が出る = to sprout. Also figurative: 才能の芽.

mnemonic.meaning: 生 grow: let it grow.
mnemonic.reading: "HAYASU!" (はやす) Hi, ya, sir: nice beard.

examples.ja: 彼はひげを生やしている。
examples.en: He has a beard.

items.note: For hair, beards, weeds. Intransitive: 生える (to grow).

mnemonic.meaning: 洒 stylish + 落 fall: stylish and relaxed.
mnemonic.reading: "OSHARE!" (おしゃれ) Oh, share your style.

examples.ja: 彼女はいつもお洒落だ。
examples.en: She's always stylish.

items.note: Usually in kana: おしゃれ.

mnemonic.meaning: 土 earth + 産 product: a product of the land.
mnemonic.reading: "MIYAGE!" (みやげ) Special reading. Me, ya, get a gift.

examples.ja: 旅行のお土産を買った。
examples.en: I bought souvenirs on my trip.

items.note: Usually お土産. In Japan you bring them back for coworkers.

mnemonic.meaning: 鼠 looks like a mouse with whiskers and a tail.
mnemonic.reading: "NEZUMI!" (ねずみ) Nezumi: the mouse.

examples.ja: 台所に鼠が出た。
examples.en: A mouse appeared in the kitchen.

items.note: Usually written ネズミ or ねずみ.

mnemonic.meaning: 救 rescue + 助 help: rescue and help.
mnemonic.reading: "KYUU, JO!" (きゅうじょ) Cute Joe helps with the rescue.

examples.ja: 山で遭難した人が救助された。
examples.en: The people lost on the mountain were rescued.

items.note: Emergencies. 助ける is everyday. 人命救助 = lifesaving.

mnemonic.meaning: 支 pay out + 出 go out: money paid out.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, SHUTSU!" (ししゅつ) She shoots money out the door.

examples.ja: 今月は支出が収入より多かった。
examples.en: This month my expenses were higher than my income.

items.note: Opposite: 収入 (しゅうにゅう, income). Formal; 出費 (しゅっぴ) is close.

mnemonic.meaning: 申 say (humble) + 訳 reason: humbly giving a reason.
mnemonic.reading: "MOUSHI, WAKE!" (もうしわけ) "Moshi moshi, wake up, sorry!"

examples.ja: 申し訳ありません。
examples.en: I'm very sorry.

items.note: Mostly in 申し訳ない / ございません, a polite apology.

mnemonic.meaning: 切 cut: a cut piece.
mnemonic.reading: "KIRE!" (きれ) From 切れる.

examples.ja: ケーキを一切れください。
examples.en: A slice of cake, please.

items.note: Counter: 一切れ (ひときれ). Also 期限切れ (expired).

mnemonic.meaning: 退 withdraw + 学 study: withdrawing from study.
mnemonic.reading: "TAI, GAKU!" (たいがく) Tie up your school bag and leave.

examples.ja: 彼は大学を退学した。
examples.en: He dropped out of university.

items.note: Leaving before graduating. 退学処分 = expulsion.

mnemonic.meaning: 都 = 者 (people) + 阝 (town, on the right): a town where people gather. A capital.
mnemonic.reading: "MIYAKO!" (みやこ) The old capital, Kyoto.

examples.ja: 京都は千年以上、日本の都だった。
examples.en: Kyoto was Japan's capital for over a thousand years.

items.note: Literary. Read と in 東京都, つ in 都合.

mnemonic.meaning: 連 take along: someone you take along.
mnemonic.reading: "TSURE!" (つれ) From 連れる (bring along).

examples.ja: 連れが来るまで待っています。
examples.en: I'm waiting for my companion.

items.note: 子連れ = with a child.

mnemonic.meaning: 宿 lodge + 泊 stay: lodging overnight.
mnemonic.reading: "SHUKU, HAKU!" (しゅくはく) Shook your hat at the inn.

examples.ja: ホテルに三日間宿泊した。
examples.en: I stayed at the hotel for three days.

items.note: Formal. 泊まる is everyday. 宿泊料 = room charge.

mnemonic.meaning: 正 proper + 規 standard: the proper standard.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY, KEY!" (せいき) Say the key's official.

examples.ja: 彼は正規の社員として採用された。
examples.en: He was hired as a regular full-time employee.

items.note: 正規雇用 = regular employment. 非正規 = non-regular.

mnemonic.meaning: 画 picture + 家 expert: an expert in pictures.
mnemonic.reading: "GA, KA!" (がか) Ga-ka: the painter.

examples.ja: ゴッホは有名な画家だ。
examples.en: Van Gogh is a famous painter.

items.note: 〜家 = an expert or professional: 作家 (writer), 音楽家.

mnemonic.meaning: 膜 has 月 (body part): a thin layer in the body.
mnemonic.reading: "MAKU!" (まく) Same sound as 幕 (curtain): a thin curtain.

examples.ja: 牛乳を温めると表面に膜ができる。
examples.en: When you heat milk, a skin forms on top.

items.note: 鼓膜 = eardrum.

mnemonic.meaning: 刑 has 刂 (knife): punishment by the blade.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY!" (けい) Okay, that's the sentence.

examples.ja: 彼は三年の刑を受けた。
examples.en: He was sentenced to three years.

items.note: Legal term. 死刑 = death penalty, 刑務所 = prison.

mnemonic.meaning: 予 beforehand + 期 expect: expecting beforehand.
mnemonic.reading: "YO, KEY!" (よき) Yo, the key you expected.

examples.ja: 予期しない出来事が起きた。
examples.en: Something unexpected happened.

items.note: Mostly in 予期せぬ / 予期しない (unexpected).

mnemonic.meaning: 党 = a group under one roof (⺌ + 兄).
mnemonic.reading: "TOU!" (とう) The party's toe in the door.

examples.ja: 彼は新しい党を作った。
examples.en: He formed a new party.

items.note: 政党 = political party. 野党 = opposition, 与党 = ruling party.

mnemonic.meaning: 知 know + 能 ability: the ability to know.
mnemonic.reading: "CHEE, NOU!" (ちのう) Cheese for the brain (脳).

examples.ja: 人工知能の研究が進んでいる。
examples.en: Research into artificial intelligence is advancing.

items.note: 人工知能 = AI. 知能指数 = IQ.

mnemonic.meaning: 湾 has 氵 (water): water curving into the land.
mnemonic.reading: "WAN!" (わん) Wan bay. 東京湾 = Tokyo Bay.

examples.ja: 船は湾の中に入った。
examples.en: The ship entered the bay.

items.note: Usually in names: 東京湾, 大阪湾.

mnemonic.meaning: 決 decide + 行 carry out: decide and carry it out.
mnemonic.reading: "KEK, KOU!" (けっこう) Same sound as 結構 (fine).

examples.ja: 雨でも試合を決行します。
examples.en: The match will go ahead even if it rains.

items.note: Doing something as planned despite bad conditions. 雨天決行 = rain or shine.

mnemonic.meaning: 宅 has 宀 (roof): a home under a roof.
mnemonic.reading: "TAKU!" (たく) Take you home.

examples.ja: 先生のお宅にお邪魔した。
examples.en: I visited my teacher's home.

items.note: Mostly お宅 (someone's home, polite) and in compounds: 自宅, 帰宅 (Level 1).

mnemonic.meaning: 墨 = 黒 (black) + 土 (earth): black earth. Ink.
mnemonic.reading: "SUMI!" (すみ) Same sound as 炭 (charcoal) and 隅 (corner).

examples.ja: 筆に墨をつけて字を書いた。
examples.en: I dipped the brush in ink and wrote characters.

items.note: Ink used in calligraphy (書道).
